reference.title: Product A: Serious Adverse Reactions
reference.shortdesc: Summary of clinical trial and post-marketing serious adverse reactions observed with Product A.

section.title: Summary of Serious Adverse Reactions for Product A
section.p: Clinically significant adverse reactions requiring medical intervention or dosage modification include:

ul.li: Febrile Neutropenia: Occurred in 5% of patients. Discontinue treatment immediately and initiate broad-spectrum anti-infectives.
Hepatotoxicity: Elevated transaminases (ALT/AST > 5x ULN) observed in 3% of patients. Dose interruption or reduction required.
Infusion-Related Reactions: Severe hypersensitivity occurred in 2% of patients during initial infusion.

section.title: Internal Review Notes
section.p: These notes are intended for internal regulatory review and should not be included in patient-facing materials.
Adverse reaction data is based on clinical trial populations; post-marketing surveillance may yield additional insights.
Ensure that all adverse reaction frequencies are updated in accordance with the latest clinical trial data and post-marketing reports.
